title: Geometric fixed-orbit construction
statement: Let R and H be commutative rings, g in R, iota : R -> H, and C a domain H-algebra finite and faithfully flat over H, with h = algebraMap H C (iota g) nonzero. Let a finite group G act on C by H-algebra homomorphisms rho. Assume D(h) in Spec C is etale over Spec H and that any two field-valued points over H on this puncture differ by a unique element of G. Let p : Y -> Spec R factor as a finite etale map to D(g). Suppose t : T -> Spec R, k : D(h) -> T is over Spec R and delta identifies Y times T with d copies of T over T. Let D be complete and distinct orbit representatives and their exact stabilizers for the induced permutation action fixedPunctureDescentAction on Fin d. Then Y times Spec H is isomorphic over Spec H to D(iota g) in the spectrum of the product of the D.stabilizer-invariant subalgebras of C.

proof.text: Convert complete and distinct orbit data, and its action equality hD, to the hypotheses of orbit-component descent. Obtain e to the coproduct of the invariant-subalgebra principal opens, with its over-H equation. Obtain f from the finite-product principal-open theorem. Compose e and f; associativity and the two equations give precisely the original projection equation.

proof_origin.note: Geometric component descent is isolated; finite-product assembly is proved separately, with the original over-H conclusion retained.

theorem affine_torsor_fixed_orbits_geometric
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    [Module.Finite H C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat H C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C (ι g) ≠ 0)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (hj : j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    [IsFinite j] [Etale j]
    (hEt : Etale (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C))))
    (hrot : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] (a b : C →+* Ω),
      a.comp (algebraMap H C) = b.comp (algebraMap H C) →
      a (algebraMap H C (ι g)) ≠ 0 →
      ∃! ζ : G, a.comp (ρ ζ).toRingHom = b)
    (d : ℕ) (D : FixedOrbitData G d)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec R)
    (k : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ⟶ T)
    (hk : k ≫ t = Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
    (δ : pullback p t ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ T)
    (hδ : δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 T) = pullback.snd p t)
    (hD : D.action = fixedPunctureDescentAction R H g ι C G ρ hρone hρmul hne
      p T t k hk d δ hδ) :
    let B := ∀ k : Fin D.m,
      (⨅ ζ : D.stabilizer k,
        AlgHom.equalizer (ρ ζ.val) (AlgHom.id H C) : Subalgebra H C)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of B)
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H B (ι g))
    ∃ θ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅ V.toScheme,
      θ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) =
        pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))

statement_change.old_statement: The geometric fixed-orbit construction produces the candidate affine scheme isomorphism, without the projection compatibility equation.
statement_change.what: Arbitrary m,K admit m=0 for a nonempty degree-one cover. Require complete, distinct orbit representatives and exact stabilizers of the induced action instead, and state the over-H equation. The first worker accidentally removed etaleness and unique rotations; restore both. Otherwise H=Q, C=Q(sqrt(2)), G trivial, g=1 and Y=T=Spec Q give a false over-Q isomorphism Spec Q = Spec C.

citers.note: The existing Core theorem accepts arbitrary m,K and is already STATEMENT-DISPUTED with a certified counterexample. It does not call this theorem. Its planned use requires a separately claimed correction to actual induced orbit data; no Core source or node is changed here.
